sections.title: Cost pools awaiting action
sections.sql: select pe.code period,pe.currency,p.code,p.name,p.owner,p.review_due,p.unallocated_cents from v_pool_review p join periods pe on pe.id=p.period_id where p.overdue or p.unallocated_cents>0 or trim(p.owner)='' order by pe.code,p.code

sections.title: Contribution by period and customer
sections.sql: select pe.code period,pe.currency,m.code,m.name,m.revenue_cents,m.direct_cents,m.overhead_cents,m.contribution_cents from v_margins m join periods pe on pe.id=m.period_id order by pe.code,m.contribution_cents
sections.note: Contribution excludes overhead that has no measured activity. Read reconciliation and resolve unallocated cost before sign-off.

sections.title: Every cent accounted for
sections.sql: select pe.code period,pe.currency,p.code,p.cost_cents,p.allocated_cents,p.unallocated_cents from v_pool_review p join periods pe on pe.id=p.period_id order by pe.code,p.code
